name: Roman Al Taglio
summary: Very wet, very light, cut with scissors and sold by weight.

steps.text: Mix to a batter-like dough with wet hands.
Four folds in the bowl, then cold ferment 24 hours.
Tip gently into an oiled tray, stretch without degassing.
Rest until bubbly, top lightly, bake hot.

bake.notes: Par-bake the base before topping for a crisper result.

notes: Degassing kills it. Move the dough as little as possible.
